player_prompt.intro:
Ame wò {player_id} le **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Dze move wò be **[macro  micro]** (agbalẽ eve 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-board siame wò dze
• *micro* = square siame mini-board siame
Dzɔdzɔɖo `[7 8]` ➜ tsɔ mark wò le mini-board 7, square 8, eye
kple woƒe opponent be wo dze le mini-board 8 ɣleti.

Ame wò `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ele be woazã [macro micro] si me xexlẽdzesiwo nye 0-8 le.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ele be xexlẽdzesi siwo le akpa sia nanye esiwo tso 0 va ɖo 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row alo col la mele teƒe si woadze o.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Ame aɖe le gaxɔa me xoxo.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ele be fefewɔla la naƒo nu le agba sue si kplɔe ɖo dzi.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Woɖu agba si nye asitelefon ƒe nyaŋuɖodzinu la dzi xoxo.

game_action.played: Agɔla {player_id} ɖu agbadja viɖe le agbadja gã {macro_idx} me, akpa {micro_idx} me (dzadza {row}, akɔnta {col}). Agɔla {opponent_id} wɔna ɖu le {nxt_txt} me.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} dzɔ Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
